import type { ModuleContext } from "@get-modular/resources";
import { createStore } from "@get-modular/observation";
import {
  createTotalDisplay, discountFor, grossTotal, vatRateFor,
  type CheckoutDeps, type CheckoutProduct, type PricingContext, type PricingOwnerDeps, type PricingOwnerProduct,
} from "./g-hierarchy.types.js";

export async function createPricingOwnerModule(deps: PricingOwnerDeps, { resources }: ModuleContext): Promise<PricingOwnerProduct> {
  // One mapping for the first value and for updates; the discount is the owner's own state and is not derived.
  const fromSettings = (values: { readonly currency: string; readonly region: string }) =>
    ({ currency: values.currency, vatRate: vatRateFor(values.region) });
  const settings = deps.settings.read(["currency", "region"]);
  const context = createStore<PricingContext>({ ...fromSettings(settings.values), discountPercent: 0 }, {
    name: "pricing/context", resources, reportError: deps.errors.report,
  });
  deps.settings.watch(settings, {
    resources, name: "pricing/settings",
    onChange: ({ values }) => { context.set(fromSettings(values)); },
  });
  const requestDiscount = (code: string): "accepted" | "rejected" => {
    const percent = discountFor(code);
    if (percent === undefined) return "rejected";
    context.set({ discountPercent: percent });
    return "accepted";
  };
  return {
    instance: undefined,
    capabilities: { "acme/pricing/context": context.readonly(), "acme/pricing/discounts": { requestDiscount } },
  };
}

export async function createCheckoutModule(deps: CheckoutDeps, { resources }: ModuleContext): Promise<CheckoutProduct> {
  const display = createTotalDisplay();
  let net = 0;
  let pricing = deps.pricing.read(["vatRate", "discountPercent"]);
  const show = (): void => { display.show(grossTotal(net, pricing.values.vatRate, pricing.values.discountPercent)); };
  show();
  deps.pricing.watch(pricing, {
    resources, name: "checkout/pricing",
    onChange: (next) => { pricing = next; show(); },
  });
  return {
    instance: display,
    capabilities: {
      "acme/checkout": {
        setNet: (amount) => { net = amount; show(); return undefined; },
        applyCode: (code) => deps.discounts.requestDiscount(code), // the owner decides; the change comes back through watch
      },
    },
  };
}
